title: Confrontation au supermarché  (Confrontation at the Supermarket)

segments.t: Tracking rival agent Elise Formain to a Parisian supermarket, Andrea finds her maneuvering a shopping cart while buying supplies for her three children. Andrea wastes no time confronting Elise over her secretive romance with producer Igor and her behind-the-scenes efforts to torpedo ASK's production. Let's listen to their confrontation in French first.
Tu me fais venir ici pour tes courses?
J'ai trois enfants à nourrir, Andréa.
Alors viens me parler franchement maintenant.
Qu'est-ce que tu veux de moi?
Tu bloques le film de Beauvois!
Igor est libre de choisir ses projets.
Tu manipules Igor contre notre agence.
Ce scénario est trop sombre et risqué.
Jean Reno a accepté le rôle principal!
Jean Reno? Tu te moques de moi?
Non, il a signé avec nous aujourd'hui.
Alors Igor devra revoir sa position.
Ne sous-estime jamais notre détermination, Élise.
Nous verrons qui gagne cette bataille.
Let's look at Andrea confronting Elise in the supermarket aisle step by step.
Tu me fais venir ici pour tes courses?
'Are you making me come here for your groceries?' Andrea expresses exasperation at the location.
J'ai trois enfants à nourrir, Andréa.
'I have three children to feed, Andrea.' Elise cites motherhood to explain her rushed schedule.
Alors viens me parler franchement maintenant.
'Then come speak to me frankly now.' Andrea insists that they stop playing games.
Qu'est-ce que tu veux de moi?
'What do you want from me?' Elise asks what brought Andrea all the way to the store.
Tu bloques le film de Beauvois!
'You are blocking Beauvois's film!' Andrea directly confronts her with the obstruction.
Igor est libre de choisir ses projets.
'Igor is free to choose his projects.' Elise attempts to shield her partner from blame.
Tu manipules Igor contre notre agence.
'You are manipulating Igor against our agency.' Andrea reveals that she sees right through the plot.
Ce scénario est trop sombre et risqué.
'This script is too dark and risky.' Elise falls back on conventional industry objections.
Jean Reno a accepté le rôle principal!
'Jean Reno accepted the lead role!' Andrea drops the bombshell that changes the balance of power.
Jean Reno? Tu te moques de moi?
'Jean Reno? Are you kidding me?' Elise struggles to mask her sudden astonishment.
Non, il a signé avec nous aujourd'hui.
'No, he signed with us today.' Andrea confirms that the contract is sealed.
Alors Igor devra revoir sa position.
'Then Igor will have to review his position.' Elise concedes that the film can no longer be ignored.
Ne sous-estime jamais notre détermination, Élise.
'Never underestimate our determination, Elise.' Andrea warns her rival not to count ASK out.
Nous verrons qui gagne cette bataille.
'We will see who wins this battle.' Elise signals that their rivalry will continue until the end. Now listen to the whole scene again at normal speed, and see how much more you catch.

Cornering Elise Formain in a grocery aisle, Andrea calls out her sabotage of Xavier Beauvois's film and delivers a stunning blow by revealing that Jean Reno has officially signed on as lead actor.
Ne sous-estime jamais notre détermination, Élise.
